title: Nutty Filipino King Prawns Bicol Express
description: A funky, crunchy, and comforting Filipino dish featuring king prawns, served in a Bicol Express style, with a keto-friendly twist, on a tagliere vessel.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the king prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, lemon juice, chopped nuts, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Nutty Filipino King Prawns Bicol Express on a tagliere vessel, garnished with additional chopped nuts and chili peppers if desired.
